metadata.title: TraceCase: An Agent That Finds Out Why
metadata.bookend_exempt_reason: Course final-project film, not a channel reel: four-part academic structure, no verdict card.
metadata.audience: INFO 7375 instructor and TAs; backend engineering hiring managers
metadata.source_doc: SCRIPT.md (2026-11-21); HolmesGPT public pages and arXiv:2501.06706v1 (read 2026-11-21)

beats.narration_text: A dashboard tells you a service broke. It doesn't tell you why.

shot.visual_intent: A dark dashboard panel stands on a cream stage with one terracotta light burning; a large question mark rises behind it and the panel stays silent.
shot.motion_claim: A dark dashboard panel stands on a cream stage with one terracotta light burning; a large question mark rises behind it and the panel stays silent.

beats.narration_text: TraceCase is an agent that reads a broken service's logs, traces and deploy history, works out why it broke, and proposes one fix a person must approve.

shot.visual_intent: A server stack sits left under a warning light; a log page, trace bars and a deploy timeline fan out beside it; a magnifier sweeps across them; one proposal card slides right and halts at a closed gate arm.
shot.motion_claim: A server stack sits left under a warning light; a log page, trace bars and a deploy timeline fan out beside it; a magnifier sweeps across them; one proposal card slides right and halts at a closed gate arm.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Finished, it's one public repository: a demo service to break on purpose, the agent, an approval screen, and an evaluation report.

shot.visual_intent: A single open box on the stage; four flat pages rise out of it in sequence and arrange into a row, each labelled beside it.
shot.motion_claim: A single open box on the stage; four flat pages rise out of it in sequence and arrange into a row, each labelled beside it.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: A team project of mine answered one question: is the service healthy? When the answer is no, an engineer reads logs by hand. That's where time goes.

shot.visual_intent: A green tick sits on a plinth left; it flips to a terracotta cross; a wall of log pages stacks up on the right and a small cursor crawls down them while a clock hand sweeps.
shot.motion_claim: A green tick sits on a plinth left; it flips to a terracotta cross; a wall of log pages stacks up on the right and a small cursor crawls down them while a clock hand sweeps.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: It's built so you can check it instead of trusting it. It does the digging, and you decide whether any fix runs.

shot.visual_intent: A claim card floats centre; a drawn arrow leaves it and lands on one highlighted line inside a log page; a second card's arrow finds nothing and the card is struck out.

show.event: arrow lands on a real line

shot.motion_claim: A claim card floats centre; a drawn arrow leaves it and lands on one highlighted line inside a log page; a second card's arrow finds nothing and the card is struck out.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: This isn't new. HolmesGPT is an open-source SRE agent, a CNCF sandbox project, about four thousand stars. It runs an agentic loop over live data, read-only by design.

shot.visual_intent: Two plinths rise on a cream stage; on the left one a magnifier orbits a ring of four small source blocks, a star count beside it, a small lock badge marking it read-only.
shot.motion_claim: Two plinths rise on a cream stage; on the left one a magnifier orbits a ring of four small source blocks, a star count beside it, a small lock badge marking it read-only.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: It's the mature option. What I couldn't find was an independent evaluation. The evidence I can read is the project describing itself.

shot.visual_intent: A badge reading mature settles on the left plinth; a second empty frame labelled independent evaluation stays blank; a loop arrow curls from the project back to itself.
shot.motion_claim: A badge reading mature settles on the left plinth; a second empty frame labelled independent evaluation stays blank; a loop arrow curls from the project back to itself.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Microsoft Research's AIOpsLab is the opposite: a benchmark, not a product. Forty-eight problems across two applications, faults injected on purpose.

shot.visual_intent: On the right plinth a grid of forty-eight small tiles assembles; two application clusters sit beneath it; a small fault bolt drops into the grid.
shot.motion_claim: On the right plinth a grid of forty-eight small tiles assembles; two application clusters sit beneath it; a small fault bolt drops into the grid.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: And it published numbers. Their best agent scored about fifty-nine percent overall. By task: detection, sixty-nine to one hundred percent; root cause, thirty-six to forty-five; mitigation, twenty-seven to fifty-five. In their words, none consistently achieve high accuracy.

shot.visual_intent: Four dim bars rise on the stage labelled beside them: detection tall, localisation mid, root cause low, mitigation low; a single terracotta rule crosses at the halfway mark.

show.event: root cause and mitigation fall short

shot.motion_claim: Four dim bars rise on the stage labelled beside them: detection tall, localisation mid, root cause low, mitigation low; a single terracotta rule crosses at the halfway mark.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: It also needs Kubernetes: its SocialNetwork application alone runs twenty-eight microservices. Not something a reviewer opens on a laptop in sixty seconds.

shot.visual_intent: A dense cluster of small service blocks piles up on the right; a closed laptop sits small beside it and does not open; a stopwatch beside the laptop stays at zero.
shot.motion_claim: A dense cluster of small service blocks piles up on the right; a closed laptop sits small beside it and does not open; a stopwatch beside the laptop stays at zero.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: So: a mature tool with thin public evidence, a benchmark that needs a cluster. TraceCase goes between them, laptop-sized, shipping the broken service.

shot.visual_intent: The two plinths slide apart and a third, smaller plinth rises between them carrying an open laptop with a tiny service and a magnifier on its lid.
shot.motion_claim: The two plinths slide apart and a third, smaller plinth rises between them carrying an open laptop with a tiny service and a magnifier on its lid.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Step one is the thing that breaks: a Spring Boot API and worker, Postgres, and Redis, in Docker Compose. Open Telemetry writes traces and logs.

shot.visual_intent: Four blocks assemble into a small isometric stack: API, worker, database cylinder, cache cylinder; thin trace lines run out of the stack into two flat files on the stage floor.
shot.motion_claim: Four blocks assemble into a small isometric stack: API, worker, database cylinder, cache cylinder; thin trace lines run out of the stack into two flat files on the stage floor.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Step two: a fixed catalogue of failures, each triggered with one command. Stale cache, slow query, bad deploy, queue backup. True causes written down first.

shot.visual_intent: Five labelled cards deal out in a row; a single switch flips and one card lights terracotta; a sealed envelope marked ground truth sits closed beneath the row.
shot.motion_claim: Five labelled cards deal out in a row; a single switch flips and one card lights terracotta; a sealed envelope marked ground truth sits closed beneath the row.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: That's my data: the system generates it. No customer logs, nothing scraped. I break my own service. The ground truth is mine because I caused it.

shot.visual_intent: A closed loop is drawn: the service emits pages that fall into a labelled tray, and the tray feeds back to the service; three outside doors stand shut around the loop.
shot.motion_claim: A closed loop is drawn: the service emits pages that fall into a labelled tray, and the tray feeds back to the service; three outside doors stand shut around the loop.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Step three is the agent. Observe, pick a tool, update the hypothesis. It stops when every claim cites a line that exists, or on a step budget, never on the model's say-so.

shot.visual_intent: A four-station ring draws itself with a travelling dot; a step counter ticks beside it; the dot halts on a seal, and a second dashed exit marked budget also halts it.
shot.motion_claim: A four-station ring draws itself with a travelling dot; a step counter ticks beside it; the dot halts on a seal, and a second dashed exit marked budget also halts it.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Its tools are an allow-list in code: read logs, query traces, read deploys. Not a shell — the Microsoft study gave its agents one. I'm deliberately not.

shot.visual_intent: Three tool pills sit inside a drawn boundary; a fourth pill marked shell is outside it and a gate arm bars its way in.
shot.motion_claim: Three tool pills sit inside a drawn boundary; a fourth pill marked shell is outside it and a gate arm bars its way in.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Every claim must cite a log line or span. A checker reopens the file; if it isn't there, the claim is rejected. Whether that line supports the diagnosis is my call.

shot.visual_intent: A claim card hands a citation to a small checker block; the checker opens a log page, finds the line and stamps the card; a second card's line is absent and the card is pushed into a reject tray.
shot.motion_claim: A claim card hands a citation to a small checker block; the checker opens a log page, finds the line and stamps the card; a second card's line is absent and the card is pushed into a reject tray.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: The fix comes from a short menu, never free text. Approval binds three things: the action, its target, and its evidence. Change one and it refuses.

shot.visual_intent: A short menu of three fix pills; one is chosen and a seal binds it to a target block and an evidence page; the target swaps and the seal cracks, and the gate arm drops.
shot.motion_claim: A short menu of three fix pills; one is chosen and a seal binds it to a target block and an evidence page; the target swaps and the seal cracks, and the gate arm drops.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Everything else is a laptop and Docker. No cluster, no GPU. Model access is the open question: my seat covers the assistant, not calls from code. So the agent targets a model interface, and a local model can stand in.

shot.visual_intent: An open laptop centre with a small compose box beside it; a cluster and a GPU card sit dim and crossed out at the edge; a model-shaped socket on the laptop stays empty with two labelled plugs waiting beside it.
shot.motion_claim: An open laptop centre with a small compose box beside it; a cluster and a GPU card sit dim and crossed out at the edge; a model-shaped socket on the laptop stays empty with two labelled plugs waiting beside it.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: About thirty scenarios from that catalogue. Ten locked away before I tune anything, so I can't quietly fit to them.

shot.visual_intent: Thirty small tiles assemble in a block; ten slide into a dark vault and a lock closes on it; twenty remain on the stage.
shot.motion_claim: Thirty small tiles assemble in a block; ten slide into a dark vault and a lock closes on it; twenty remain on the stage.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: The baseline gets the same model and the same logs, traces and deploy history, in one prompt. No loop, no tools, no checker.

shot.visual_intent: A log page is dropped whole into a model pill and one answer card falls out; beside it the three machinery pieces from earlier sit dim and unused.
shot.motion_claim: A log page is dropped whole into a model pill and one answer card falls out; beside it the three machinery pieces from earlier sit dim and unused.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Four measurements. Did it name the right cause. Did it say I don't know when evidence was missing. How many unsupported claims survived — I score those by hand. And how many steps it burned.

shot.visual_intent: Four counters appear in a row with labels beside them; the second counter is ticked with a check rather than a cross; the third shows a bold zero target.
shot.motion_claim: Four counters appear in a row with labels beside them; the second counter is ticked with a check rather than a cross; the third shows a bold zero target.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: It worked if it names more correct causes than the baseline on the held-out ten, and no unsupported claim survives. It failed if it only wins by guessing more often.

shot.visual_intent: Two bars face each other over the held-out vault: TraceCase and baseline; a terracotta line marks the pass mark; a guess-more arrow is drawn and then crossed out.
shot.motion_claim: Two bars face each other over the held-out vault: TraceCase and baseline; a terracotta line marks the pass mark; a guess-more arrow is drawn and then crossed out.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: And one test that's simply pass or fail. Approve fix A, swap in fix B, and the system must refuse.

shot.visual_intent: A sealed approval card marked A sits at a gate; a hand swaps in a card marked B; the seal cracks and the gate arm stays down with a terracotta refusal mark.
shot.motion_claim: A sealed approval card marked A sits at a gate; a hand swaps in a card marked B; the seal cracks and the gate arm stays down with a terracotta refusal mark.

qc.sparse_reason: show-tell style: one drawn object or scene on a cream stage per beat, minimal labels, the voice carries the explanation. Only underfill and clustered are waived; edge-bleed, empty-frame and contrast still apply.

beats.narration_text: Where it stands tonight: a brief, this plan, and this film. No TraceCase code exists yet. Everything you just heard is what I'm going to build.

shot.visual_intent: Two shelves on the cream stage: the lower shelf labelled exists holds a brief page and a film reel; the upper shelf labelled will exist holds ghosted outlines of the service, agent, gate and report.
shot.motion_claim: Two shelves on the cream stage: the lower shelf labelled exists holds a brief page and a film reel; the upper shelf labelled will exist holds ghosted outlines of the service, agent, gate and report.
